units.source_text: 在紫花地丁的下面、枫树的根旁，竖着一个古色古香的灯笼。

en.t: Beneath the violets, beside the roots of the maple tree, stood an old-fashioned lantern with an antique charm.

units.source_text: 记得有一回，千重子的父亲告诉她，灯笼脚上雕刻的立像是基督。

en.t: She remembered that once, Chieko's father had told her that the standing figure carved on the base of the lantern was Christ.
